scope: Independent production readback only; no repeated checkpoint, local PG tests, migration or production repair action.
user_authorization: 批准该 checkpoint 生产修复及回读验证
receipt_boundary: The duplicate response provides checkpoint_id/version but no receipt_id. This independent readback did not submit a duplicate checkpoint; it confirmed the original Receipt through read-only SQL with exact checkpoint/owner/binding/version/operation/base_version=9 linkage. It does not claim the duplicate response contains a Receipt reference.

operations.note: Supported resume may maintain its normal service session/audit metadata; no claim of zero internal service writes.

query:
select pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() as observed_at_utc,
 pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex') as body_sha256,
 pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex') as definition_sha256,
 p.prosecdef as security_definer,p.proconfig as function_config,p.proacl::text as grants,
 (select count(*) from public.clued_context_checkpoints where id='2e667626-c5f0-4ff5-a421-240f7349894f'::uuid) as checkpoint_count,
 (select count(*) from public.clued_audit_receipts where id='9dd27c49-6874-476c-83c2-ddbac3f168a9'::uuid) as receipt_id_count,
 (select count(*) from public.clued_audit_receipts r join public.clued_context_checkpoints c on r.object_id=c.id::text and r.user_id=c.user_id and r.binding_id=c.binding_id and r.version=c.version where c.id='2e667626-c5f0-4ff5-a421-240f7349894f'::uuid and r.operation='checkpoint') as original_bound_receipt_count,
 (select count(*) from public.clued_context_checkpoints where idempotency_key='phase2-checkpoint-production-repair-20260908-v10') as same_key_checkpoint_count,
 (select version from public.clued_context_checkpoints where id='2e667626-c5f0-4ff5-a421-240f7349894f'::uuid) as checkpoint_version,
 (select context_key from public.clued_context_checkpoints where id='2e667626-c5f0-4ff5-a421-240f7349894f'::uuid) as checkpoint_context_key,
 (select count(*) from public.clued_audit_receipts r join public.clued_context_checkpoints c on r.object_id=c.id::text and r.user_id=c.user_id and r.binding_id=c.binding_id and r.version=c.version where c.id='2e667626-c5f0-4ff5-a421-240f7349894f'::uuid and r.id='9dd27c49-6874-476c-83c2-ddbac3f168a9'::uuid and r.operation='checkpoint' and r.metadata->>'base_version'='9') as exact_original_receipt_binding_count
 from pg_catalog.pg_proc p where p.oid='public.clued_mcp_commit_checkpoint(text,jsonb)'::regprocedure;
